quote: When when my mom passed away, they Oh, Oh, I'm sorry.
stewart_read: Customer discloses her mother's recent death mid-search for the bill; rep says nothing in response on the transcript.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have responded off-mic or the moment was brief/unclear in diarization, but no acknowledgment appears anywhere in the visible transcript.
coaching_implication: Even a brief 'I'm sorry to hear that' costs nothing and builds trust — this is a trust gift the rep let pass silently.

quote: Do you all do solars on townhouses?
stewart_read: Customer volunteers a proactive qualifying question before the rep even starts, signaling real interest.
coaching_implication: Rep could have used this energy to build rapport ('great question, let me walk you through it') instead of moving straight into ownership verification.

quote: Now that, I have to ask Ernest because he is the one staying in it right now.
stewart_read: First sign the bill isn't accessible; rep presses forward asking if she can reach him rather than immediately pivoting to the text/photo path.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have been testing if a quick call to Ernest was faster than switching tools — but this ties up multiple minutes with no result.
coaching_implication: Per bill_collection.alternative_paths, pivot within 2 minutes of friction — this took over 5.

quote: His mailbox is full, and he's not answering.
stewart_read: Second touch on the same bill-access friction; the failed call to Ernest confirms the paper/phone path is dead, but rep still doesn't redirect immediately.
coaching_implication: This is the moment to say 'no worries, I'll just text you a link' — instead she continues rifling through drawers for two more minutes.

quote: the cove bill, he said, was around about 140.
stewart_read: A usable bill figure ($140) is finally surfaced but the rep moves straight to the roof question without acknowledging or flipping it.
coaching_implication: Bill capture without the emotional flip — rep should have said something like 'that adds up fast, that's the kind of bill we help eliminate' before pivoting to roof type.

quote: I sent you a text, and then you can just send a picture of that back. And then I'll call you back whenever, and then I'll schedule you.
stewart_read: Call ends with no locked day/time and no 'is that fair?' handshake — a fully open-ended callback.
coaching_implication: Rep should have proposed a specific follow-up day/time even if the appointment itself is contingent on the bill photo.
